results.title: Russia, China sign long-term energy and trade agreements — Sixty
results.snippet:
Russia and China signed long-term agreements in Beijing on energy, agriculture and technology on Wednesday, 18 November 2026. A joint statement said the two sides welcomed the rise in bilateral trade settled in their own currencies to more than 90%. It also said a new pipeline carrying natural gas from Siberia to China was completed ahead of schedule.
